name: Kibun wa Pastel Touch
original_name: 気分はぱすてるたっち
source:
Main character is count Dracula and he proposes to a Japanese girl Umi. Response is put on hold till Dracula picks her up in the daytime. Three months later he visits her school as a male student to charm girls with magic and get Umi whereabouts from them.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是德古拉伯爵，他向日本女孩海求婚。海没有立刻答应，只说要等德古拉在白天来接她时再给答复。三个月后，德古拉化作男学生来到她的学校，用魔法迷住女孩们，从她们口中打听海的去向。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
